Serving your suburb

Macarthur Showers Fixed at the Source

The heat and the clay soils of the Macarthur region move homes through the seasons, cracking grout and splitting silicone. In the older brick-and-tile homes it is aged waterproofing; in the newer builds it is usually an early seal failure. Homes of this age share a few common causes, covered in why is my shower leaking?

A shower of that age can nearly always be repaired. We can reseal a leaking shower, cut out and replace worn grout, and re-waterproof the recess if the membrane has finished its life. Campbelltown is covered in the same way as all Sydney areas we service, with the inspection done at your home.

The signs to watch for

Spotting a Leaking Shower in a Macarthur Home

A leak in a thirty-year-old bathroom rarely starts with a flood. It starts with small changes that are easy to live with for a while. These are the ones worth acting on.

A soft spot in the floor outside the shower

Particleboard and timber swell when they stay wet. A floor that gives slightly underfoot near the bathroom door has been taking in water.

Cracked tiles along the shower hob

The hob takes knocks and movement. Once its tiles crack, water gets into the hob and out under the screen.

Brown staining on the garage ceiling

In a two-storey Macarthur home the main bathroom often sits over the garage, where a stain can go unnoticed for months.

Grout that has turned orange or black

Discoloured grout that will not scrub clean is holding moisture, and the stain is mould or mineral coming up from below.

A screen door that drips outside the recess

When the bottom seal or the channel under the screen fails, water runs out across the bathroom floor each time the shower is used.

Paint peeling on the hallway side of the wall

Flaking or bubbling paint on the wall that backs onto the shower is caused by moisture coming through from the wet side.

The right repair for the real cause

Repairs That Hold Up in Macarthur Heat

Macarthur summers are hot enough to shorten the life of sealants, so we choose materials made for wet areas and replace what has worn out, not just what is visible.

Resealing

Silicone that has dried out and shrunk is removed from every junction and replaced with a mould-resistant sealant that stays flexible.

Regrouting

Stained and broken-down grout is cut out and replaced. Epoxy grout is used on the shower floor, where water sits longest.

Re-waterproofing

When a bathroom from the 1970s or 1980s has reached the end of its original waterproofing, we re-waterproof the shower area to AS 3740 and provide the certificate.

Base and junction repairs

Cracked hob tiles, a failed base joint or a loose waste are repaired and sealed so water stays inside the recess.

Repair or replace

Should You Repair or Replace a Campbelltown Shower?

In most Campbelltown homes the answer is repair. The tiles in a thirty-year-old bathroom are often still firmly bonded, and only the seals, grout or membrane underneath have worn out. Replacing the whole room makes sense when the floor has rotted or you were planning to renovate anyway. If you are unsure, the comparison below is a fair starting point.

  • Whether a hob or base needs repair as well
  • One storey or two, and what sits under the bathroom
  • The dimensions of the shower recess

Campbelltown Shower Repair Questions

Do hot Macarthur summers shorten the life of a shower?
They do. Hot summers dry out silicone so it shrinks and cracks, and seasonal ground movement works on the grout. In a home that is thirty or more years old, that adds to ordinary wear.
Can you fix the leak without ripping out my bathroom?
In most cases, yes. The silicone, grout, base or membrane is repaired from inside the shower, and the tiles and fittings stay where they are.
Do you service Ingleburn, Minto and Glenfield as well as Campbelltown?
Yes, all of those. Leumeah and Kentlyn are covered too, and a specialist comes to your home.
How long will I wait for an inspection in Campbelltown?
Not long. Inspections in the Macarthur area are usually booked within the same week, and urgent leaks are given priority.
What does it cost to repair a shower in a Macarthur home?
It depends on what has worn out. Replacing silicone is the smallest job, and re-waterproofing the recess is the largest. After the inspection you receive an itemised, fixed-scope quote in writing.
Is it worth repairing a thirty-year-old shower?
Usually. If the tiles are still firmly fixed, replacing the worn seals, grout or membrane stops the leak for far less than a new bathroom, and the work carries our 100% workmanship guarantee in writing.
